CrossMux 1.5.8 adds end-to-end content synchronization for Xteink X3 and X4 devices, with matching international and Simplified Chinese firmware builds.

## Highlights

- Add a firmware-side content sync screen for downloading images and ebooks from a configured sync server.
- Stream files directly to the SD card with HTTP range support, SHA-256 verification, resumable `.part` files, and rollback-safe `.bak` replacement.
- Validate remote paths before writing and clear affected EPUB caches after successful updates.
- Add a web-configurable content sync server URL and localized English/Simplified Chinese UI strings.
- Add a self-hosted .NET 10 sync service with authenticated upload/delete operations, content manifests, range downloads, SHA-256 metadata, and an OPDS catalog.
- Add Docker deployment files, service documentation, automated tests, and CI coverage.

## Firmware assets

- `firmware.bin`: international firmware for X3/X4 (device model is detected at runtime).
- `firmware-cn.bin`: Simplified Chinese firmware for X3/X4 (device model is detected at runtime).
- `bootloader.bin` and `partitions.bin`: installation support files shared by both builds.

## Upgrade notes

- Configure the content sync server URL from the device web settings, then start synchronization from the System menu.
- Existing books, reader progress, and settings remain compatible. EPUB pagination cache is refreshed only for synchronized EPUB files.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/sunkejava/crossmux/compare/1.5.7...1.5.8
